prompts.user1:
Please take the scRNA-seq AnnData file at

/path/to/scrna_counts.h5ad

Perform a preprocessing pipeline on the data. Assume a sample column already exists in adata.obs so no metadata inference is needed. First, do basic filtering by removing genes expressed in fewer than 500 cells and cells expressing fewer than 500 genes. Then identify mitochondrial genes using prefixes "MT-" or "mt-", compute QC metrics including pct_counts_mt, and remove cells with mitochondrial percentage at or above 20%. After that, drop all mitochondrial genes from the dataset.

Next, select 2000 highly variable genes using Seurat v3 flavor with sample as the batch key, normalize total counts to 1e4, apply log1p transformation, run PCA with 20 components, and perform Harmony integration using sample as the batch variable for 30 iterations (please use harmonypy directly rather than calling it through scanpy), storing the corrected embedding in X_pca_harmony. Generate and save visualization outputs including QC metric distributions (n_genes_by_counts, total_counts, pct_counts_mt), a PCA plot, and a UMAP embedding computed from the Harmony embedding, optionally colored by sample. Do not save any intermediate or final h5ad, and do not display plots.

Output the intermediate and result files to
